page.overview:
What is Kutsukku Island?

Kutsukku Island is an island located in the South Blue and unaffiliated with the World Government. It is the country where Eustass Kid, Killer, Heat, and Wire were born.

Nothing is currently known about the country's geography beyond the fact that it has four towns.

In the past, Kid, Killer, Heat, and Wire were bosses of gangs ruling the island's four towns. After his childhood friend Victoria was murdered by another rival gang, Kid unified the four groups and took down the rival gang. Afterwards, the unified gangs formed into the pirate crew known as the Kid Pirates.
